title: RBI Amends Commercial Bank Financial Disclosure Directions Effective April 1, 2027
description: RBI's Eighth Amendment Directions, 2026 delete LCR, NSFR and remuneration disclosure requirements from commercial bank financial disclosure norms effective 1 April 2027.The post RBI Amends Commercial Bank Financial Disclosure Directions Effective April 1, 2027 appeared first on TaxGuru.
